test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

When Shruti called Naufal, he __was given the team a briefing of__ the project.

options.text: has been giving the team a briefing of
was giving the team a briefing of
was gave the team a briefing of
had been given the team a briefing of

solution:
The correct answer is **Option(2) i.e. "was giving the team a briefing of"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence incorrectly mixes passive voice ("was given") with what should be **an active description** of the action **taking place**.
 
• The correct phrase** "was giving" **puts the subject (he) in an active role.
 
• The correct form** "was giving" **denotes that Naufal was in the process of delivering a briefing to the team, aligning with the continuous past tense indicated by the context of the sentence.

**Therefore, the correct sentence is- ***"When Shruti called Naufal, he **was giving the team a briefing of**__ the project."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (**"has been giving the team a briefing of") uses the present perfect continuous tense incorrectly as the context is in the simple past.
 
• **Option 3 **("was gave the team a briefing of") is grammatically incorrect due to the use of "was gave," which mixes past simple with a past participle without auxiliary verbs correctly.
 
• **Option 4 (**"had been given the team a briefing of") incorrectly implies that Naufal was the recipient of the briefing, not the one giving it, due to the passive voice.
